New explanatory prose introduces no additional letter family or symbol collision.

issues.message: The abstract announces four regimes, but the Introduction immediately announces two regimes using the same unqualified term. The subsequent theorem pairs make the intended grouping inferable, but the opening does not tell the reader that four result cases are being organized into two broader index settings. The adjacent counts therefore look inconsistent at the paper's first orientation point.
issues.requested_change: Clarify that hierarchy in the new motivation paragraph: describe the two broad index settings and explicitly relate them to the four result cases, or otherwise use wording that reconciles the counts. Preserve the agreed abstract and all protected theorem/setup text; no additional mathematical notation or general rewrite is needed.
